sources.title: BlockFusion wins approval to reopen bitcoin mine on Frontier Avenue

profile.campus_note: One of 11 buildings OpenStreetMap contributors have mapped under this name in this locality, numbered west to east.
profile.research_note: Session 2026-09-03: local press names the operating entity "Northeast Data LLC" doing business as BlockFusion. All 10 OSM nodes for this name sit within ~250m of each other on the same Frontier Avenue industrial site and resolve to the same address via Nominatim reverse geocode; treated as one multi-building campus, not 10 distinct facilities.

reading.body:
BlockFusion Niagara Falls is a multi-building campus on Frontier Avenue in western New York whose operator has not published IT power specifications. The site was approved in 2026 to reopen as a bitcoin mining operation, and research has not yet recovered published megawatt figures from operator spec pages for this facility.

New York state has 31 mapped data center facilities, of which only one operator has published IT power capacity to this site. BlockFusion Niagara Falls ranks second by published megawatts in the state, though this ranking reflects the absence of published specs from other facilities rather than confirmed capacity data for this campus.

Without published power specifications, the scale of this campus relative to AI infrastructure buildout cannot be assessed. The lack of disclosed IT load figures leaves its role in New York's data center capacity opaque, despite its apparent physical scale and state-level ranking.
